_note: Day One, part 2 of 2: a short briefing in the office, head back out, cross the grounds to the boys' dorm court, a crowd gathers for a forced practice fight (seven guided steps, each gated on the real combat event), the crowd leaves, then walk through the dorm door to an original end card. Beats follow docs/re-notes/opening-slice-recon.md B0-B8 + the epilogue in section 5; ALL text here is our own wording. Combat events (docs/re-notes/combat.md): block_success, combo_done, grapple_start, grapple_strike, grapple_strikes_done, grapple_done, ground_kick, enemy_beaten, humiliation_done, enemy_knocked_out, player_knocked_out. NPC cues (Config/NPCScripts/day_one.json): npc_crowd_gather (fight start), enemy_knocked_out disperses the crowd by itself, npc_crowd_clear. Mission flags read by the combat AI: combat_ai_passive (no swings), combat_ai_noblock. GAPS the framework cannot express in data (reported, not worked around in C++): the sparring partner must be spawned with the console command Combat.SpawnEnemy 5 (event combat_spawn_partner marks where a mission action should do it), likewise Combat.Invulnerable 1 for the tutorial; no fade action (the end card is a HUD banner); the dorm door has no BullyDoorLink pair, so the epilogue uses a teleport action. Start with Mission.Start 1_02 (teleports to the principal's room) or play the combined day_one mission.
title: Day One: The Dorm Court

stages.objective: Listen to your first instructions for the day.

on_start.sub: Your first morning at the academy

on_start.text: You have been given a room in the boys' dorm. Go and find it.

stages.objective: Head back down to the entrance hall.
Leave the main building.
Cross the grounds to the boys' dorm.

on_start.text: The dorm is across the grounds, to the south.

stages.objective: A crowd is forming in the dorm court.

on_start.sub: Someone wants to see what you are made of

stages.objective: Practice step 1 of 7: block his punch (1 of 2).

on_start.text: Hold Block (Q or LB) just as his punch comes in.

stages.objective: Practice step 1 of 7: block his punch (2 of 2).
Practice step 2 of 7: land a three-punch combo.

on_start.text: Press Attack (left mouse or B) three times in a row. Hold the right mouse button or RT to lock on.

stages.objective: Practice step 3 of 7: grab him.

on_start.text: Get close and press Grapple (F or RB) to take hold of him.

stages.objective: Practice step 4 of 7: hit him three times while you hold him.

on_start.text: While holding him, press Attack three times.

stages.objective: Practice step 5 of 7: take hold of him again.
Practice step 6 of 7: throw him to the ground.

on_start.text: While holding him, press Grapple again to push him down.

stages.objective: Practice step 7 of 7: kick him while he is down.

on_start.text: Stand over him and press Attack to kick.

stages.objective: Finish the fight. Use everything you have learned.
He is beaten. Grab him to finish it.

on_start.text: Press Grapple (F or RB) on your beaten opponent.

stages.objective: Watch him go down.
The crowd is breaking up.
Someone with authority is heading this way.

on_start.text: Time to leave before you are caught in the middle of this.

stages.objective: Go to your room through the dorm door.
You made it to your room.

on_start.sub: The rest of the term is still ahead of you
